# NotificationPermission

`Flare.Components.NotificationPermission`

The user's answer to the browser's notification permission prompt.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | Not decided yet: the prompt has not been answered, so it can still be shown. |
| `Granted` | `1` | Notifications are allowed. |
| `Denied` | `2` | Notifications are blocked. The page cannot prompt again; only the browser's site settings can change it. |
| `Unsupported` | `3` | The browser has no notifications, or the page is not interactive yet. |
